value.content:
A Claude Code mod is an instruction file: a SKILL.md that tells the agent how to work. This one teaches it to analyze a binary with no source code. On screen: the skill itself, then file, strings and objdump, with real output, then the password, the vault open.

Every claim points to a line of real output. Only on your own binary, or a CTF.

The presenter is a drawing made from my photos; the voice is mine, cloned by AI.

#Shorts #ReverseEngineering #ClaudeCode #Assembly #Linux #Programming
